condition: Requirement REQ-0014 mandates that the service go live by 2027-01-11, leaving only 41 days from contract award assuming a 2026-12-01 award date.
event: Integration with the student records system via REST API (REQ-0009) encounters unexpected authentication or schema hurdles, delaying go-live past 2027-01-11.
effect: The service fails to launch for students on the first day of spring enrollment, breaching contract terms.
assumptions: The College's existing REST API is fully documented and immediately accessible upon contract award.
trigger: API documentation is not provided within three days of contract award.
responses: Request API documentation and sandbox access prior to contract award.
Prepare a fallback manual roster import mechanism if API integration is delayed.
residual_exposure: Manual import requires operational overhead and risks student friction during spring enrollment.

condition: Requirement REQ-0008 suggests migrating signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28, which is after the student go-live date of 2027-01-11.
event: Support staff attempt to access historical signed records during the spring enrollment period before migration is finished, and cannot find them in the new system.
effect: Administrative delays and compliance confusion occur when staff must query two separate systems during enrollment.
assumptions: Users will tolerate checking the legacy tool for historical records until the end of February 2027.
trigger: Migration script testing reveals data format mismatches from the legacy tool.
responses: Prioritize migration of the most frequently accessed form templates before 2027-01-11.
Provide staff with clear documentation on how to access legacy archives.
residual_exposure: Staff time is wasted navigating dual systems until full migration completes on 2027-02-28.
